ValidationRule.description: Opportunity must have a campaign before moving to any stage
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ( OR( ISPICKVAL(Owner.Team__c, "Benchmarking"), INCLUDES(Owner.Brands__c, "Expert Insight - GXRs"), INCLUDES(Owner.Brands__c, "Expert Insight - IP") ) && ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won – Pending Approval") && ISBLANK(Campaign__c) && $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator' ) || ( text(Owner.Team__c )= 'Performance Data - Lexology WWL' && ISBLANK(Campaign__c) && text(StageName )<> 'Identify' && $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A campaign must be selected before saving this opportunity. Please go back and choose a campaign from the Campaign field, then try saving again
